quarterly_data.quarter: Hubei Feilihua Quartz Glass IR activity record: 2026-10-08 (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record, board secretary Peng Wei): H1 2026 R&D investment was RMB 1.61 hundred million, up 31.62%, focused on quartz materials for optics, semiconductors and electronics. It has developed high-purity synthetic quartz glass ingots of over 2 tons per ingot, now in stable volume production and sales, for large-size high-end optical quartz; titanium-doped ultra-low-expansion synthetic quartz glass made breakthrough progress in single-ingot weight and size, with expansion coefficient and optical uniformity close to the international advanced level (company view); and improved VAD deposition and heat treatment produced large-aperture, high-optical-uniformity, low-hydroxyl synthetic quartz.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 R&D RMB 1.61 hundred million (+31.62%); synthetic quartz ingots over 2 tons each in volume production

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): the Hefei Guangwei photomask-substrate precision-processing project's product process stability and market fit have been recognised by customers and it is gradually moving into batch shipments; the Jinan Guangwei high-end electronic special-materials precision-processing project has completed its basic-specification mass-production line and is optimising the volume process, with higher-end products developed in parallel as planned.
